tools.name: transcribe_huddle_recording
tools.description: Runs the premium transcription engine on a huddle recording and charges the workspace's saved payment method for the minutes transcribed. Returns the transcript text and the charge ID.

params.name: recording_path
params.description: Path to the huddle audio recording file.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the workspace being billed.

tools.code:
import subprocess
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

CENTS_PER_MINUTE = 6


@dataclass
class TranscriptionResult:
    transcript: str
    minutes: int
    charge_id: str


@tool
def transcribe_huddle_recording(recording_path: str, stripe_customer_id: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(["huddle-transcribe", "--input", recording_path, "--format", "text"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=1800)
    seconds = float(proc.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1].split("=")[-1])
    minutes = max(1, math.ceil(seconds / 60))
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=minutes * CENTS_PER_MINUTE, currency="usd", customer=stripe_customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f"Huddle transcription: {minutes} min")
    return TranscriptionResult(transcript=proc.stdout, minutes=minutes, charge_id=intent.id).__dict__

tools.name: move_attachment_to_shared_drive
tools.description: Moves a file from a channel's uploads into the team's shared drive folder and posts a notice about the move to the team's external incoming webhook.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel the attachment was uploaded to.

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the uploaded file to move.

params.name: shared_folder
params.description: Subfolder of the shared drive to move the file into.

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests
from agents import function_tool

UPLOADS_ROOT = Path("/srv/chat/uploads")
SHARED_DRIVE = Path("/mnt/shared-drive")
WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ["TEAM_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL"]


@function_tool
def move_attachment_to_shared_drive(channel_id: str, filename: str, shared_folder: str) -> dict:
    src = UPLOADS_ROOT / channel_id / filename
    dest_dir = SHARED_DRIVE / shared_folder
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = Path(shutil.move(str(src), str(dest_dir / filename)))
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={"text": f"`{filename}` from channel {channel_id} was moved to shared drive folder `{shared_folder}`."}, timeout=10)
    return {"moved_to": str(dest), "notified": resp.ok, "webhook_status": resp.status_code}

tools.name: archive_stale_channel_messages
tools.description: Runs the message integrity checker for a channel and, if it passes, moves messages older than the given number of days from the live messages table into the archived messages table.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel whose old messages should be archived.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Messages older than this many days are moved to the archive.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/srv/chat/data/workspace.db"
CHECKER = "/srv/chat/bin/check_message_integrity"


@contextmanager
def _transaction(path: str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        yield conn
        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


@function_tool
def archive_stale_channel_messages(channel_id: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    if older_than_days < 1:
        return {"error": "older_than_days must be at least 1."}

    check = subprocess.run(
        [CHECKER, "--db", DB_PATH, "--channel", channel_id, "--read-only"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    if check.returncode != 0:
        return {
            "channel_id": channel_id,
            "archived": 0,
            "error": "Integrity check failed; nothing was archived.",
            "checker_output": (check.stdout + check.stderr).strip()[-2000:],
        }

    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    with _transaction(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO archived_messages (id, channel_id, author_id, body, thread_ts, created_at) "
            "SELECT id, channel_id, author_id, body, thread_ts, created_at FROM messages "
            "WHERE channel_id = ? AND created_at < ?",
            (channel_id, cutoff),
        )
        moved = cur.rowcount
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM messages WHERE channel_id = ? AND created_at < ? "
            "AND id IN (SELECT id FROM archived_messages WHERE channel_id = ?)",
            (channel_id, cutoff, channel_id),
        )

    return {
        "channel_id": channel_id,
        "cutoff": cutoff,
        "archived": moved,
        "integrity_check": "passed",
    }
